APPROVE

Moving the two `if`/`&&` blocks into helpers removes their nesting-weighted cost from the method (17 should drop to roughly 9–13), and the helpers keep the same conditions, the same order of checks, and the same `SourceTextRef` arguments, so behaviour is unchanged. I judged this from the diff alone, since there is no checkout here to build or run the analyzer against. The one thing I couldn't confirm is that `sourceTextRefs` is declared as a `List<SourceTextRef>`, which the build depends on.
